knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The solar customer buys clean panels, a written note of what was checked, and a warranty position they can rely on. The hourly rate, equipment list and business age are not the outcome.
A guarantee must be something you can deliver and afford, or it damages the business.
A claim about output must be substantiated by evidence that supports it. The lesson says not to sell an output gain you cannot show.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
